result_semantics: new exploratory measured-data calculation; not approved manuscript replacement

likelihood.observations: raw unrebinned integer detector counts per channel
likelihood.line_shape: unit-normalized Gaussian plus unit-normalized left-exGaussian charge-loss mixture, integrated over calibrated bin edges
likelihood.resolution: declared per-table form; Table 3 canonical sigma_keV = sqrt(intercept_keV^2 + variance_slope_keV * nominal_line_energy_keV)
likelihood.background: declared nonnegative Bernstein affine or quadratic counts/s/keV density evaluated at calibrated bin centers, with a free common background-scale nuisance for each run after the first
likelihood.multi_run_signal: shared within-class line rates times separate free neutron-capture and radioactive-decay signal-scale nuisances for each Table 3 run after the first; origin class is frozen per component, including explicit H-1 capture and Ar-41 decay assignments
likelihood.calibration: common offset and fractional-gain-stretch nuisances with declared Gaussian constraints; Table 3 additionally declares zero-centered per-run offset/stretch deviations and relative resolution-scale nuisances for runs after the reference run
likelihood.canonical_intervals: Fisher covariance for regular interior fits; 95% profile likelihood for ratios with a weak/boundary numerator or denominator; Table 3 separately adds declared model-variant RMS sensitivity for exploratory regular-ratio intervals

selection.reason: Only public reactor-on low-gain RD family matching the no-added-water/no-added-floor-lead shield description; public catalog contains no Cycle 498 run.

table3.simultaneous_fit_reason: All four files share the exact database calibration, detector, orientation, shield, and run family, but backgrounds, neutron-capture intensity, and radioactive-decay intensity vary by run; counts are not combined. One scalar run intensity is rejected by the data because capture and decay compositions vary independently.

origin_class_policy.assignment: explicit per component; no identity-string pattern matching
origin_class_policy.within_class_estimand: run-invariant line ratio under the fitted class-scale model
origin_class_policy.cross_class_estimand: reference-run-relative composition ratio; not a run-invariant observable and not suitable for manuscript replacement

calibration_constraint.warning: The release gives A0/A1 but no calibration covariance or run-to-run drift covariance. The common constraint and zero-centered per-run deviation constraints (sigma 0.25 keV offset and 1e-4 fractional stretch) are declared applicability assumptions, not released metrology. Spectrum index 0 is the reference; later-run deviations are relative to it.

resolution_initial.per_run_scale_warning: The release supplies no run-specific resolution uncertainty. Relative scales for spectra after index 0 have independent Gaussian constraints centered at 1 with sigma 0.12; this is a declared sensitivity assumption.

reference_core_diagnostic.energy_convention: released nominal calibrated bin centers; half-open interval

reference_core_systematic.method: maximum absolute run-level fractional observed-minus-expected balance in the declared reference core after the per-run origin-scale and drift-nuisance refit, restricted to long runs
reference_core_systematic.covariance: rank-one fully correlated denominator-scale covariance across every non-self ratio; the self-ratio sensitivity is exactly zero
reference_core_systematic.reason: Separate capture/decay run scales cure the coherent long-run reference-core imbalance, but the rd_558 window still rejects the model; the remaining long-run core residual envelope is retained as an explicit exploratory denominator sensitivity. The 813.89 s run is reported but excluded from envelope estimation because its core has only about 70 expected counts.

origin_composition_systematic.method: maximum absolute fitted radioactive-decay-to-neutron-capture composition change among non-reference long runs, computed as the inverse capture-to-decay double ratio minus one to match the reported ratio orientation
origin_composition_systematic.applies_to: radioactive_decay numerator divided by neutron_capture reference only
origin_composition_systematic.covariance: rank-one fully correlated across cross-origin ratios; zero for neutron-capture self-class ratios
origin_composition_systematic.reason: Capture and radioactive-decay intensities vary independently between runs, so cross-origin ratios are reference-run-relative rather than run-invariant observables.

residual_provenance_notes.observation: Reviewer residual audit found a repeated isolated fixed-energy residual near the modeled 609.3 keV line.
residual_provenance_notes.treatment: No extra line is asserted without released identity/provenance; the residual remains visible in per-bin and window diagnostics and contributes to non-applicability.

table8.simulation_policy: Measured-data candidates only. Missing monoenergetic simulations are neither fabricated nor summed; each future simulation must be fit separately with a declared case identity.
table8.contaminant_policy: No separately identified contaminant is asserted in phase 1. All twelve lines in the 7.6-7.7 MeV FEP/SEP/DEP cluster are explicit target multiplet components. Elevated window deviance is reported as possible unmodeled structure, not hidden in automatic peak discovery.
